summary: Implementation plan for transforming the application into a colorful, comic-book-styled Chess Review & Bot Arena. Features a vibrant default light theme, 33 tiered bots with 50-Elo increments (400-2000 Elo), dynamic comic sound effect badges with rich variety (KABOOM, POW, ZAP, OUCH, SPLAT), and interactive bot personality speech bubbles that react in real time to the player's good and bad moves.
